Definition: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage
BiblicalUsage: 1) to bear, bringforth, beget, gender, travail; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to bear, bring forth; 1a1a) of child birth; 1a1b) of distress (simile); 1a1c) of wicked (behaviour); 1a2) to beget; 1b) (Niphal) to be born; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to cause or help to bring forth; 1c2) to assist or tend as a midwife; 1c3) midwife (participle); 1d) (Pual) to be born; 1e) (Hiphil); 1e1) to beget (a child); 1e2) to bear (fig. -of wicked bringing forth iniquity); 1f) (Hophal) day of birth, birthday (infinitive); 1g) (Hithpael) to declare one's birth (pedigree)
